description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover the exact analysis framework and output templates. (2) Parse the messy raw_client_notes.txt to extract user profile data (age 35, IT engineer, married with child, 42万 income, 13000/month mortgage) AND four policy records (重疾险 30万/4500元, 医疗险 300万/680元/10000免赔额, 定期寿险 100万/1500元, 意外险 50万/200元). (3) Produce analysis_report.md in client_cases/case_2024_0318/ containing: a 保单梳理表 (Section 3.1) with all mandatory fields including 等待期 and 免赔额; a 综合评估 (Section 3.2) using exactly the four dimensions 覆盖全面性/保额充足性/费用合理性/家庭适配度 with ⭐ star ratings; a 问题诊断 (Section 3.3) using 【】 bracketed problem tags (e.g., 【保额不足】) flagging the 重疾险 30万 as insufficient; an 优化建议 (Section 3.4) using 【优先级：高/中/低】 priority structure; AND must NOT recommend specific products from the product database (Section 4 compliance), redirecting the company-comparison question to professional consultation instead.
